IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Linville, Orcutt, Quall, Cody, Hinkle, Hurst and Dunn

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax deduction for the sale of certain prescription drugs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to business and occupation tax deductions for drugsdispensed pursuant to prescription; and adding a new section to chapter82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In computing tax there may be deducted from the measure of taximposed by RCW 82.04.290(2) amounts received by physicians or clinicsfor drugs for infusion or injection by licensed physicians for humanuse pursuant to a prescription, but only if the amounts are separatelystated on invoices or other billing statements and do not exceed thethen current federal rate. The federal rate means the rate at or belowwhich the federal government or its agents reimburse providers forprescription drugs administered to patients as provided for in themedicare, part B, drugs average sales price information resource aspublished by the United States department of health and human services,or any successor index thereto.
